per_candidate.id: s2:ALMA and JWST Identification of Faint Dusty Star-forming Galaxies up to z ∼ 8 an

rationale: None of the candidate papers directly investigate the halo mass function of galaxies at redshifts z > 4 or compare it to the predictions of the standard cosmological model in light of observed massive and dusty galaxies. They are related to the topic but do not address the specific question.
